Hi team,

Quick update from the floor: keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk response flow tight and calm today. We are still seeing callers who need the basics laid out clearly before departure, and that steady guidance is what keeps the handoff smooth. Please check every file for the travel steps already recorded, then confirm the missing items before you move the case forward.

For the next shift, stay alert for pet-size questions, crate fit checks, and document follow-up. I want clean notes, clear status updates, and no loose ends left for the next coordinator. If a traveler asks for extra help, keep the tone warm and direct, and route the issue promptly instead of letting it sit.

Yara Yilmaz is already in the queue, and Talia Cohen may call back later, so be ready with the file details when those names come up. <<FACT F068>> Keep the discussion practical and keep the desk moving. If Ziggy is mentioned, treat the case the same way as any other pet record and follow the standard review steps without delay.

Thanks for staying sharp and keeping Aurelia Skyways service consistent throughout the shift.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
